items.title: 8.16 Chemical equilibrium ke sanati istemalat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.16, printed page 183.

blocks.text: Sanat ki bunyadi zaroorat product ki zyada se zyada yield hai, aur equilibrium ka tasawwur dikhata hai ke use kaise hasil karein. Bari sanati ahmiyat ki do reversible reactions Haber process se ammonia ka banna aur contact process se sulfuric acid ke liye sulfur trioxide ka banna hain; dono exothermic gas reactions hain jin ke halaat Le Chatelier ke usool aur munasib rate ki zaroorat se chune jate hain.

blocks.alt: Baen: darja hararat ke muqable ammonia ki yield ka graph jis mein 10 se 1000 atm ke paanch girte curves hain, oonche dabao oonche, aur nuqtedar daira 400 degrees C aur 200 se 300 atm ke qareeb sanati halaat nishan-zada karta hai. Daen: neela dabba 200 se 800 K tak ammonia ki Kc qeematon aur behtareen halaat ke saath, aur narangi dabba SO3 ki darja hararat, Kc aur mole feesad ki table aur contact process ke halaat ke saath.
blocks.caption: Haber process ke liye darja hararat aur dabao ke muqable yield, aur contact process ka SO3 equilibrium (Figure 8.4 aur Tables 8.1 aur 8.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka; curves schematic).
blocks.long_description: Ammonia ki yield kam darja hararat aur zyada dabao par sab se zyada hai, 200 degrees C aur 1000 atm par 98.3 feesad tak, magar kam darja hararat par reaction bohat sust hai, to sanat loha catalyst ke saath 200 se 300 atm par 400 degrees C ke qareeb kaam karti hai. Ammonia ka Kc 200 K par 7.15 x 10^15 se 800 K par 3.96 x 10^-2 tak girta hai. Sulfur trioxide ke liye Kc 200 degrees C par 5500 se 700 degrees C par 13 tak aur yield 98 se 31 feesad tak girti hai, to gases 1 atm par vanadium pentoxide par guzarti aur 400 se 500 degrees C par recycle hoti hain.

blocks.prompt: Dono sanati amal behtareen yield dene wale darja hararat se zyada darja hararat istemal karte hain. Kyun?
blocks.explanation: Dono reactions exothermic hain, to kam darja hararat bara Kc aur zyada equilibrium yield deta hai, magar kam darja hararat par rate itni sust hai ke amal ghair-iqtisadi hai. Catalyst ke saath darmiyana darja hararat munasib waqt mein qabil-e-qubool yield deta hai; catalyst yield mazeed ghataye baghair rate bahal karta hai.

items: Sanat zyada se zyada yield chahti hai; Haber aur contact processes Le Chatelier ka usool (dabao, darja hararat, product hatana) lagate hain jabke catalyst se rate iqtisadi rakhte hain.
